name: Harbor master
design: Very broad mature male with olive mottled hide, heavy square cranium, long tusked exposed mandibles, shoulder-length thick dreadlocks with plain copper rings. Sleeveless charcoal wrap tunic with raised leather collar, two broad diagonal harness straps and small bronze shoulder tabs, heavy stitched knee apron. Carries a rectangular sealed navigation tablet under left arm; right hand on belt with three cargo seals. Clawed feet bare with ankle wraps; solid relaxed stance.
